Free, and takes a minute:

  1. Install the ntfy app (App Store or Google Play).
  2. Open it and tap + (Subscribe to topic on Android, Add subscription on iPhone).
  3. Turn on Use another server and enter the Service URL: https://ntfy.example.com
  4. Topic name: pstonn-abc — then Subscribe.
  5. Tap Send a test to my phone below, then Confirm on the notification when it arrives.
One more step: confirm your phone. Tap Send a test to my phone, then Confirm on the notification when it arrives. That tells p.stonn the notifications are getting through — you can turn off email once you have.

Whatever you choose here, safety alerts always come by email: a change p.stonn couldn’t make, a council connection that needs re-linking, a permit about to expire, and outage notices.

Hold notices from until — then they're delivered.

Changes still happen as soon as p.stonn can make them — only the notification waits, so a midnight roster change reaches you as a morning confirmation. Anything that needs your action is sent straight away.
